messages.subject: Project Falcon - completion timetable and funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Mark,

We're targeting exchange and completion on 10 October. Attached for your sign-off is the draft funds flow: £22.9m completion payment to the sellers' solicitors, £1.5m to escrow, plus SDRT (£127k, payable post-completion), our fees and Marlow Tax's DD fees. Please confirm the source split between existing cash and the RCF drawdown so we can finalise.

The completion checklist is also attached. Tom will run the bring-down searches on the 9th.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
